title: Willow weep for me
lyrics_synced:
[00:18.52] Willow Weep For Me
[00:21.55] Willow Weep For Me
[00:24.68] Bend your branches green
[00:26.66] Along the stream that runs to sea
[00:30.83] Listen to my plea
[00:33.89] Listen willow and weep for me
[00:43.11] Gone my lover's dream
[00:46.20] Lovely summer dream
[00:49.25] Gone and left me here
[00:51.27] To weep my tears into the stream
[00:55.45] Sad as I can be
[00:58.72] Hear me willow and weep for me
[01:07.13] Whisper to the wind
[01:10.56] And say that love has sinned
[01:13.55] To leave my heart a breaking
[01:16.18] And making a moan
[01:19.71] Murmur to the night
[01:22.82] To hide her starry light
[01:26.21] So none will find me sighing
[01:28.73] And crying all alone
[01:32.36] Weeping willow tree
[01:35.44] Weep in sympathy
[01:38.52] Bend your branches down
[01:40.53] Along the ground and cover me
[01:45.46] When the shadows fall
[01:48.19] Bend, oh willow, and weep for me
